name: Coed-Alun
text: Coed-Alun is the Welsh form of the name of Koadalan. Koadalan is the hero of a Breton tale of magical change and denied immortality. Collectors gathered the tale from spoken tradition in the 1800s. The tale carries kinship with medieval Welsh literature. Its episodes run so loose that some modern commentators call it the Saga of Koadalan. See Koadalan.

attributes.value: Welsh form of the Breton hero name Koadalan
name built from Welsh words for wood and the Allen river

okr.objective: Coed-Alun is the Welsh form of Koadalan, hero of a Breton transformation tale.
key_results: Coed-Alun (Welsh, wood of Allen) is the Welsh form of the name of Koadalan, hero of a Breton tale of magical change and denied immortality.
The tale is so episodic that some modern commentators call it the Saga of Koadalan.
Collected from oral tradition in the 19th century, it carries kinship with medieval Welsh literature.
